topics.topic: Bayanin Haruffan Hausa: Baƙaƙe da wasula, haruffa masu tagwayen sauti
learningObjectives: Fahimtar jimillar haruffan Hausa (baƙaƙe da wasula)
Gane wasula guda biyar (a, e, i, o, u) da gajeru da dogaye
Bayyana haruffa masu tagwayen sauti (ƙ, ɗ, ɓ, ts, 'y) a fili

topics.topic: Ƙa'idojin Rubutun Hausa: Raba kalmomi, haɗa kalmomi, da amfani da alamomin rubutu
learningObjectives: Fahimtar ƙa'idojin haɗa kalma da raba kalma a rubuce
Amfani da alamomin rubutu (aya, waƙafi, alamar tambaya) yadda ya dace
Kauce wa kuskuren rubutu a kalmomin yau da kullum

topics.topic: Kayan Sautin Hausa: Ƙwarewar furuci, gajerun wasula da dogayen wasula
learningObjectives: Bambanta tsakanin gajerun wasula da dogayen wasula
Koya yadda ake furta sautuka daban-daban a bakin mutum
Gane tasirin tsawon sauti wajen canza ma'anar kalma

topics.topic: Rabe-raben Kalmomi: Suna (suna na gama-gari da sunan kanka)
learningObjectives: Bada ma'anar suna a tsarin nahawun Hausa
Bambanta tsakanin sunan kanka (proper noun) da sunan gama-gari (common noun)
Yin amfani da suna wajen gina cikakkiyar jumla

topics.topic: Al'adun Gaisuwa a Ƙasar Hausa: Gaisuwar safe, rana, da ta girmama manya
learningObjectives: Bayyana mahimmancin gaisuwa a al'adar Hausawa
Koya yadda ake gaishe da iyaye da manya cikin ladabi da biyayya
Gane gaisuwar yanayi daban-daban (ina kwana, barka da yamma, barka da rana)
Koya sassan insha'i (gabatarwa, jigon bayani, da kammalawa)
Rubuta gajeren insha'i mai ma'ana game da makarantarsu
Amfani da ingantaccen rubutun Hausa ba tare da kuskuren haruffa ba

topics.topic: Gwajin Tsakiyar Zango da Tantance Sakamako
learningObjectives: Auna fahimtar ɗalibai a kan haruffa, sautuka, da rabe-raben suna
Gyara kurakuran da aka samu a rubutun insha'i
Ƙarfafa gwiwar ɗalibai wajen haɓaka ilimin harshen Hausa

topics.topic: Adabin Gargajiya: Tatsuniyoyi, karin magana, da waƙoƙin baka
learningObjectives: Bada ma'anar adabin baka da rabe-rabensa
Bayar da labarin tatsuniya mai ɗauke da Gizo da Koki
Fito da darussan tarbiyya da gargaɗi da ke cikin tatsuniya

topics.topic: Tsayayyun Al'adu: Bukukuwan aure, haihuwa, da sana'o'in gargajiya a Arewa
learningObjectives: Bayyana yadda ake gudanar da bikin aure da na sanya suna a ƙasar Hausa
Gane abubuwan da al'adar Hausa ta amince da su wajen neman aure
Kare kyawawan al'adun Hausa daga gurbacewa

topics.topic: Karin Magana a Harshen Hausa: Ma'ana da amfaninsu a zantuka
learningObjectives: Bayyana ma'anar karin magana a matsayin mai gyara zance
Koya shahararrun karin magana (misali: zama lafiya ya fi zama ɗan sarki)
Amfani da karin magana wajen zance a cikin aji

topics.topic: Sana'o'in Gargajiya: Ƙira, jima, saƙa, da rini a ƙasar Hausa
learningObjectives: Gano tsofaffin sana'o'in da Hausawa suka shahara da su
Bayyana kayan aikin da maƙera, marina, da masāƙa ke amfani da su
Bayyana amfanin sana'o'in hannu ga tattalin arziƙin al'umma

topics.topic: Bita Kan Dukkan Darussan Zango don Shirin Jarabawa
learningObjectives: Sake duba dukkan darussan da aka koyar a fannin nahawu, al'ada, da adabi
Amsa tambayoyin da suka gabata don ƙarin sani
Shirya ɗalibai don fuskantar jarabawar ƙarshen zango cikin kwarin gwiwa

topics.topic: Jarabawar Ƙarshen Zango da Rubuta Sakamako
learningObjectives: Gudanar da cikakkiyar jarabawar rubutu da ta baka a harshen Hausa
Tantance makin ɗalibai bisa tsarin da ma'aikatar ilimi ta amince da shi
Shigar da sakamakon jarabawa a littafin bayanan makaranta
